question: Should built-in Orgo support require an operator-managed workspace and permanently prohibit workspace deletion, or should the provider wait or remain external until Orgo offers atomic safe workspace cleanup?
rationale: Orgo's cascading delete lacks a conditional or version precondition, so a local inventory check cannot prevent deletion of a concurrently added unrelated computer; selecting the ownership boundary changes the public provider contract.

options.title: Require managed workspace
options.body: Make `orgo.workspaceId` mandatory, manage only exact claimed computers, and never issue workspace deletes.

options.title: Wait for Orgo API
options.body: Defer built-in support until Orgo provides conditional, versioned, or non-cascading workspace deletion.

options.title: Keep integration external
options.body: Close the built-in proposal and leave Orgo support to a custom integration if core should not own this contract.

recommendation.title: Require managed workspace
recommendation.body: Make `orgo.workspaceId` mandatory, manage only exact claimed computers, and never issue workspace deletes.
